verses.original: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ εἶναι αὐτὸν ἐν τόπῳ τινὶ προσευχόμενον ὡς ἐπαύσατο εἶπέν τις τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ πρὸς αὐτόν Κύριε δίδαξον ἡμᾶς προσεύχεσθαι καθὼς καὶ Ἰωάννης ἐδίδαξεν τοὺς μαθητὰς αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai egeneto en tō einai auton en topō tini proseuchomenon hōs epausato eipen tis tōn mathētōn autou pros auton Kyrie didaxon hēmas proseuchesthai kathōs kai Iōannēs edidaxen tous mathētas autou
verses.literal: One day . . . . . . in a place where Jesus had just finished praying one of His disciples requested . . . . . . Lord teach us to pray just as John taught his disciples
verses.literalPt: Estava Jesus orando em certo lugar e, quando acabou, disse-lhe um de seus discípulos: Senhor, ensina-nos a orar, como João ensinou a seus discípulos.

verses.original: Εἶπεν δὲ αὐτοῖς Ὅταν προσεύχησθε λέγετε Πάτερ ἁγιασθήτω τὸ ὄνομά σου Ἐλθέτω ἡ βασιλεία σου
verses.transliteration: Eipen de autois Hotan proseuchēsthe legete Pater hagiasthētō to onoma sou Elthetō hē basileia sou
verses.literal: So Jesus told them When you pray say Father hallowed be Your name Your kingdom come
verses.literalPt: Ele lhes respondeu: Quando orardes, dizei: Pai, santificado seja o teu nome; venha o teu reino;

verses.original: Τὸν ἄρτον ἡμῶν τὸν ἐπιούσιον δίδου ἡμῖν τὸ καθ’ ἡμέραν
verses.transliteration: Ton arton hēmōn ton epiousion didou hēmin to kath’ hēmeran
verses.literal: Give us each day our daily bread
verses.literalPt: o pão nosso de cada dia dá-nos diariamente;

verses.original: Καὶ ἄφες ἡμῖν τὰς ἁμαρτίας ἡμῶν Καὶ γὰρ αὐτοὶ ἀφίομεν παντὶ ὀφείλοντι ἡμῖν Καὶ μὴ εἰσενέγκῃς ἡμᾶς εἰς πειρασμόν
verses.transliteration: Kai aphes hēmin tas hamartias hēmōn Kai gar autoi aphiomen panti opheilonti hēmin Kai mē eisenenkēs hēmas eis peirasmon
verses.literal: And forgive us our sins for we also forgive everyone who sins against us And lead us not into temptation
verses.literalPt: e perdoa-nos os nossos pecados, porque nós também perdoamos a todo aquele que nos deve; e não nos deixes cair em tentação.

verses.original: Καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς Τίς ἐξ ὑμῶν ἕξει φίλον καὶ πορεύσεται πρὸς αὐτὸν μεσονυκτίου καὶ εἴπῃ αὐτῷ Φίλε χρῆσόν μοι τρεῖς ἄρτους
verses.transliteration: Kai eipen pros autous Tis ex hymōn hexei philon kai poreusetai pros auton mesonyktiou kai eipē autō Phile chrēson moi treis artous
verses.literal: Then Jesus said to them Suppose one of you goes to - his friend at midnight and says . . . Friend lend me three loaves of bread
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe mais: Se um de vós tiver um amigo, e for procurá-lo à meia-noite, e lhe disser: Amigo, empresta-me três pães,

verses.original: ἐπειδὴ φίλος μου παρεγένετο ἐξ ὁδοῦ πρός με καὶ οὐκ ἔχω ὃ παραθήσω αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: epeidē philos mou paregeneto ex hodou pros me kai ouk echō ho parathēsō autō
verses.literal: because a friend of mine has come to me on a journey and I have nothing to set before him
verses.literalPt: porque um amigo meu acaba de chegar à minha casa de uma viagem, e nada tenho para lhe oferecer;

verses.original: Κἀκεῖνος ἔσωθεν ἀποκριθεὶς εἴπῃ Μή μοι κόπους πάρεχε ἤδη ἡ θύρα κέκλεισται καὶ τὰ παιδία μου μετ’ ἐμοῦ εἰς τὴν κοίτην εἰσίν οὐ δύναμαι ἀναστὰς δοῦναί σοι
verses.transliteration: Kakeinos esōthen apokritheis eipē Mē moi kopous pareche ēdē hē thyra kekleistai kai ta paidia mou met’ emou eis tēn koitēn eisin ou dynamai anastas dounai soi
verses.literal: And suppose the one inside answers . . . Do not bother me My door is already shut and my children and I are in bed I cannot get up to give you anything
verses.literalPt: e, se do interior, o outro lhe responder: Não me incomodes; a porta já está fechada, e eu e meus filhos estamos deitados; não posso levantar-me para tos dar.

verses.original: Λέγω ὑμῖν εἰ καὶ οὐ δώσει αὐτῷ ἀναστὰς διὰ τὸ εἶναι φίλον αὐτοῦ διά γε τὴν ἀναίδειαν αὐτοῦ ἐγερθεὶς δώσει αὐτῷ ὅσων χρῄζει
verses.transliteration: Legō hymin ei kai ou dōsei autō anastas dia to einai philon autou dia ge tēn anaideian autou egertheis dōsei autō hosōn chrēzei
verses.literal: I tell you even though he will not get up to provide for him because of his friendship yet because of the man’s persistence he will get up and give him as much as he needs
verses.literalPt: Digo-vos: Embora não se levante para lhos dar por ser seu amigo, ao menos por causa da sua importunação se levantará e lhe dará quantos pães precisar.

verses.original: Κἀγὼ ὑμῖν λέγω αἰτεῖτε καὶ δοθήσεται ὑμῖν ζητεῖτε καὶ εὑρήσετε κρούετε καὶ ἀνοιγήσεται ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: Kagō hymin legō aiteite kai dothēsetai hymin zēteite kai heurēsete krouete kai anoigēsetai hymin
verses.literal: So I tell you Ask and it will be given to you seek and you will find knock and the door will be opened to you
verses.literalPt: Eu vos digo: Pedi, e dar-se-vos-á; buscai, e achareis; batei, e abrir-se-vos-á.

verses.original: πᾶς γὰρ ὁ αἰτῶν λαμβάνει καὶ ὁ ζητῶν εὑρίσκει καὶ τῷ κρούοντι ἀνοιγήσεται
verses.transliteration: pas gar ho aitōn lambanei kai ho zētōn heuriskei kai tō krouonti anoigēsetai
verses.literal: For everyone who asks receives he who seeks finds and to him who knocks the door will be opened
verses.literalPt: Pois todo o que pede recebe; o que busca acha; e, ao que bate, abrir-se-lhe-á.

verses.original: Τίνα δὲ ἐξ ὑμῶν τὸν πατέρα αἰτήσει ὁ υἱὸς ἰχθύν καὶ ἀντὶ ἰχθύος ὄφιν αὐτῷ ἐπιδώσει
verses.transliteration: Tina de ex hymōn ton patera aitēsei ho huios ichthyn kai anti ichthyos ophin autō epidōsei
verses.literal: What father among you if his son asks for a fish will give him a snake instead . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Qual de vós é o pai que, se o filho pedir peixe, lhe dará, em vez de peixe, uma serpente?

verses.original: ἢ καὶ αἰτήσει ᾠόν ἐπιδώσει αὐτῷ σκορπίον
verses.transliteration: ē kai aitēsei ōon epidōsei autō skorpion
verses.literal: Or . . . if he asks for an egg will give him a scorpion
verses.literalPt: Ou, se pedir um ovo, lhe dará um escorpião?

verses.original: εἰ οὖν ὑμεῖς πονηροὶ ὑπάρχοντες οἴδατε δόματα ἀγαθὰ διδόναι τοῖς τέκνοις ὑμῶν πόσῳ μᾶλλον ὁ Πατὴρ ὁ ἐξ οὐρανοῦ δώσει Πνεῦμα Ἅγιον τοῖς αἰτοῦσιν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: ei oun hymeis ponēroi hyparchontes oidate domata agatha didonai tois teknois hymōn posō mallon ho Patēr ho ex ouranou dōsei Pneuma Hagion tois aitousin auton
verses.literal: So if you who are evil know how to give good gifts to your children how much more will your Father in heaven give the Holy Spirit to those who ask Him
verses.literalPt: Se vós, sendo maus, sabeis dar boas dádivas a vossos filhos, quanto mais vosso Pai celestial dará o Espírito Santo aos que lho pedirem.

verses.original: Καὶ ἦν ἐκβάλλων δαιμόνιον καὶ αὐτὸ ἦν κωφόν ἐγένετο δὲ τοῦ δαιμονίου ἐξελθόντος ἐλάλησεν ὁ κωφός καὶ ἐθαύμασαν οἱ ὄχλοι
verses.transliteration: Kai ēn ekballōn daimonion kai auto ēn kōphon egeneto de tou daimoniou exelthontos elalēsen ho kōphos kai ethaumasan hoi ochloi
verses.literal: One day Jesus was driving out a demon that was mute And when . . . the demon was gone the man who had been mute spoke The crowds were amazed
verses.literalPt: Estava Jesus expelindo um demônio, e era este mudo. Tendo saído o demônio, falou o mudo, e maravilhou-se a multidão.

verses.original: τινὲς δὲ ἐξ αὐτῶν εἶπον Ἐν Βεελζεβοὺλ τῷ ἄρχοντι τῶν δαιμονίων ἐκβάλλει τὰ δαιμόνια
verses.transliteration: tines de ex autōn eipon En Beelzeboul tō archonti tōn daimoniōn ekballei ta daimonia
verses.literal: but some of them said It is by Beelzebul the prince of the demons that He drives out demons
verses.literalPt: Mas alguns deles disseram: É por Belzebu, príncipe dos demônios, que ele expele os demônios;

verses.original: ἕτεροι δὲ πειράζοντες σημεῖον ἐξ οὐρανοῦ ἐζήτουν παρ’ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: heteroi de peirazontes sēmeion ex ouranou ezētoun par’ autou
verses.literal: And others tested Him by demanding a sign from heaven
verses.literalPt: outros, para o experimentarem, lhe pediam um sinal do céu.

verses.original: Αὐτὸς δὲ εἰδὼς αὐτῶν τὰ διανοήματα εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Πᾶσα βασιλεία ἐφ’ ἑαυτὴν διαμερισθεῖσα ἐρημοῦται καὶ οἶκος ἐπὶ οἶκον πίπτει
verses.transliteration: Autos de eidōs autōn ta dianoēmata eipen autois Pasa basileia eph’ heautēn diameristheisa erēmoutai kai oikos epi oikon piptei
verses.literal: Knowing their thoughts Jesus said to them Every kingdom divided against itself will be laid waste and a house divided against a house will fall
verses.literalPt: Ele, porém, conhecendo-lhes os pensamentos, disse: Todo reino dividido contra si mesmo será desolado, e cairá uma casa sobre outra.

verses.original: εἰ δὲ καὶ ὁ Σατανᾶς ἐφ’ ἑαυτὸν διεμερίσθη πῶς σταθήσεται ἡ βασιλεία αὐτοῦ ὅτι λέγετε ἐν Βεελζεβοὺλ ἐκβάλλειν με τὰ δαιμόνια
verses.transliteration: ei de kai ho Satanas eph’ heauton diemeristhē pōs stathēsetai hē basileia autou hoti legete en Beelzeboul ekballein me ta daimonia
verses.literal: If Satan is divided against himself how can his kingdom stand After all you say that I drive out demons by Beelzebul
verses.literalPt: Também se Satanás está dividido contra si mesmo, como subsistirá o seu reino? Pois dizeis que eu expulso os demônios por Belzebu.

verses.original: εἰ δὲ ἐγὼ ἐν Βεελζεβοὺλ ἐκβάλλω τὰ δαιμόνια οἱ υἱοὶ ὑμῶν ἐν τίνι ἐκβάλλουσιν διὰ τοῦτο αὐτοὶ ὑμῶν κριταὶ ἔσονται
verses.transliteration: ei de egō en Beelzeboul ekballō ta daimonia hoi huioi hymōn en tini ekballousin dia touto autoi hymōn kritai esontai
verses.literal: And if I drive out demons by Beelzebul by whom do your sons drive them out So then . . . they will be your judges
verses.literalPt: Se eu expulso os demônios por Belzebu, por quem os expelem vossos filhos? Por isso, eles mesmos serão os vossos juízes.

verses.original: εἰ δὲ ἐν δακτύλῳ Θεοῦ ἐγὼ ἐκβάλλω τὰ δαιμόνια ἄρα ἔφθασεν ἐφ’ ὑμᾶς ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: ei de en daktylō Theou egō ekballō ta daimonia ara ephthasen eph’ hymas hē basileia tou Theou
verses.literal: But if I drive out demons by the finger of God then the kingdom of God has come upon you
verses.literalPt: Mas, se pelo dedo de Deus eu expulso os demônios, logo, é chegado a vós o reino de Deus.

verses.original: Ὅταν ὁ ἰσχυρὸς καθωπλισμένος φυλάσσῃ τὴν ἑαυτοῦ αὐλήν ἐν εἰρήνῃ ἐστὶν τὰ ὑπάρχοντα αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Hotan ho ischyros kathōplismenos phylassē tēn heautou aulēn en eirēnē estin ta hyparchonta autou
verses.literal: When a strong man fully armed guards his house his possessions are secure
verses.literalPt: Quando o homem valente, bem armado, guardar a sua casa, os seus bens estão seguros.

verses.original: ἐπὰν δὲ ἰσχυρότερος αὐτοῦ ἐπελθὼν νικήσῃ αὐτόν τὴν πανοπλίαν αὐτοῦ αἴρει ἐφ’ ᾗ ἐπεποίθει καὶ τὰ σκῦλα αὐτοῦ διαδίδωσιν
verses.transliteration: epan de ischyroteros autou epelthōn nikēsē auton tēn panoplian autou airei eph’ hē epepoithei kai ta skyla autou diadidōsin
verses.literal: But when someone stronger . . . attacks and overpowers him he takes away the armor in which the man trusted and then he divides up his plunder
verses.literalPt: Mas, quando sobrevier outro mais valente do que ele e o vencer, tira-lhe toda a armadura em que confiava e reparte os seus despojos.

verses.original: Ὁ μὴ ὢν μετ’ ἐμοῦ κατ’ ἐμοῦ ἐστιν καὶ ὁ μὴ συνάγων μετ’ ἐμοῦ σκορπίζει
verses.transliteration: Ho mē ōn met’ emou kat’ emou estin kai ho mē synagōn met’ emou skorpizei
verses.literal: He who is not with Me is against Me and he who does not gather with Me scatters
verses.literalPt: Quem não é por mim é contra mim; e quem comigo não ajunta espalha.

verses.original: Ὅταν τὸ ἀκάθαρτον πνεῦμα ἐξέλθῃ ἀπὸ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου διέρχεται δι’ ἀνύδρων τόπων ζητοῦν ἀνάπαυσιν καὶ μὴ εὑρίσκον τότε λέγει Ὑποστρέψω εἰς τὸν οἶκόν μου ὅθεν ἐξῆλθον
verses.transliteration: Hotan to akatharton pneuma exelthē apo tou anthrōpou dierchetai di’ anydrōn topōn zētoun anapausin kai mē heuriskon tote legei Hypostrepsō eis ton oikon mou hothen exēlthon
verses.literal: When an unclean spirit comes out of a man it passes through arid places seeking rest and does not find it Then it says I will return to the house I left
verses.literalPt: Quando o espírito imundo tiver saído do homem, anda por lugares áridos, procurando repouso; e, não o achando, diz: Voltarei para minha casa, donde saí;

verses.original: καὶ ἐλθὸν εὑρίσκει σεσαρωμένον καὶ κεκοσμημένον
verses.transliteration: kai elthon heuriskei sesarōmenon kai kekosmēmenon
verses.literal: On its return it finds the house swept clean and put in order
verses.literalPt: e, ao chegar, acha-a varrida e adornada.

verses.original: τότε πορεύεται καὶ παραλαμβάνει ἕτερα πνεύματα πονηρότερα ἑαυτοῦ ἑπτά καὶ εἰσελθόντα κατοικεῖ ἐκεῖ καὶ γίνεται τὰ ἔσχατα τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐκείνου χείρονα τῶν πρώτων
verses.transliteration: tote poreuetai kai paralambanei hetera pneumata ponērotera heautou hepta kai eiselthonta katoikei ekei kai ginetai ta eschata tou anthrōpou ekeinou cheirona tōn prōtōn
verses.literal: Then it goes and brings seven other spirits more wicked than itself and they go in and dwell there And the final plight of that man is worse than the first
verses.literalPt: Depois, vai, e leva consigo mais sete espíritos piores do que ele, e ali entram e habitam; o último estado daquele homem fica sendo pior do que o primeiro.

verses.original: Ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν τῷ λέγειν αὐτὸν ταῦτα ἐπάρασά τις φωνὴν γυνὴ ἐκ τοῦ ὄχλου εἶπεν αὐτῷ Μακαρία ἡ κοιλία ἡ βαστάσασά σε καὶ μαστοὶ οὓς ἐθήλασας
verses.transliteration: Egeneto de en tō legein auton tauta eparasa tis phōnēn gynē ek tou ochlou eipen autō Makaria hē koilia hē bastasasa se kai mastoi hous ethēlasas
verses.literal: As . . . . . . Jesus was saying these things a woman in the crowd raised her voice and said Blessed is the womb that bore You and blessed are the breasts that nursed You
verses.literalPt: Enquanto assim falava, uma mulher, do meio da multidão, levantou a voz e disse-lhe: Bem-aventurado o ventre que te trouxe, e os peitos a que foste criado!

verses.original: Αὐτὸς δὲ εἶπεν Μενοῦν μακάριοι οἱ ἀκούοντες τὸν λόγον τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ φυλάσσοντες
verses.transliteration: Autos de eipen Menoun makarioi hoi akouontes ton logon tou Theou kai phylassontes
verses.literal: But He replied Blessed rather are those who hear the word of God and obey it
verses.literalPt: Mas ele respondeu: Antes, bem-aventurados aqueles que ouvem a palavra de Deus e a observam!

verses.original: Τῶν δὲ ὄχλων ἐπαθροιζομένων ἤρξατο λέγειν Ἡ γενεὰ αὕτη γενεὰ πονηρά ἐστιν σημεῖον ζητεῖ καὶ σημεῖον οὐ δοθήσεται αὐτῇ εἰ μὴ τὸ σημεῖον Ἰωνᾶ
verses.transliteration: Tōn de ochlōn epathroizomenōn ērxato legein Hē genea hautē genea ponēra estin sēmeion zētei kai sēmeion ou dothēsetai autē ei mē to sēmeion Iōna
verses.literal: As the crowds were increasing Jesus said This - is a wicked generation It demands a sign but none will be given it except . . . the sign of Jonah
verses.literalPt: Como afluíssem as multidões, começou a dizer: Esta é uma geração perversa; pede um sinal, e nenhum sinal se lhe dará, senão o de Jonas.

verses.original: καθὼς γὰρ ἐγένετο Ἰωνᾶς τοῖς Νινευίταις σημεῖον οὕτως ἔσται καὶ ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου τῇ γενεᾷ ταύτῃ
verses.transliteration: kathōs gar egeneto Iōnas tois Nineuitais sēmeion houtōs estai kai ho Huios tou anthrōpou tē genea tautē
verses.literal: For as Jonah was a sign to the Ninevites so . . . the Son of Man will be a sign to this generation
verses.literalPt: Pois, assim como Jonas foi um sinal para os ninivitas, assim também o Filho do Homem o será para esta geração.

verses.original: Βασίλισσα νότου ἐγερθήσεται ἐν τῇ κρίσει μετὰ τῶν ἀνδρῶν τῆς γενεᾶς ταύτης καὶ κατακρινεῖ αὐτούς ὅτι ἦλθεν ἐκ τῶν περάτων τῆς γῆς ἀκοῦσαι τὴν σοφίαν Σολομῶνος καὶ ἰδοὺ πλεῖον Σολομῶνος ὧδε
verses.transliteration: Basilissa notou egerthēsetai en tē krisei meta tōn andrōn tēs geneas tautēs kai katakrinei autous hoti ēlthen ek tōn peratōn tēs gēs akousai tēn sophian Solomōnos kai idou pleion Solomōnos hōde
verses.literal: The Queen of the South will rise at the judgment with the men of this generation and condemn them for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon and now One greater than Solomon is here
verses.literalPt: A rainha do Sul se levantará, no juízo, juntamente com os homens desta geração e os condenará; pois veio dos confins da terra para ouvir a sabedoria de Salomão; e aqui está quem é maior do que Salomão.

verses.original: ἄνδρες Νινευῖται ἀναστήσονται ἐν τῇ κρίσει μετὰ τῆς γενεᾶς ταύτης καὶ κατακρινοῦσιν αὐτήν ὅτι μετενόησαν εἰς τὸ κήρυγμα Ἰωνᾶ καὶ ἰδοὺ πλεῖον Ἰωνᾶ ὧδε
verses.transliteration: andres Nineuitai anastēsontai en tē krisei meta tēs geneas tautēs kai katakrinousin autēn hoti metenoēsan eis to kērygma Iōna kai idou pleion Iōna hōde
verses.literal: The men of Nineveh will stand at the judgment with this generation and condemn it for they repented at the preaching of Jonah and now One greater than Jonah is here
verses.literalPt: Os ninivitas se levantarão, no juízo, juntamente com esta geração e a condenarão; porque se arrependeram com a pregação de Jonas; e aqui está quem é maior do que Jonas.

verses.original: Οὐδεὶς λύχνον ἅψας εἰς κρύπτην τίθησιν οὐδὲ ὑπὸ τὸν μόδιον ἀλλ’ ἐπὶ τὴν λυχνίαν ἵνα οἱ εἰσπορευόμενοι τὸ φέγγος βλέπωσιν
verses.transliteration: Oudeis lychnon hapsas eis kryptēn tithēsin oude hypo ton modion all’ epi tēn lychnian hina hoi eisporeuomenoi to phengos blepōsin
verses.literal: No one lights a lamp and puts it in a cellar or under a basket Instead he sets it on a stand so those who enter can see the light
verses.literalPt: Ninguém, depois de acender uma candeia, a põe em um lugar escondido nem debaixo do módio, mas sobre o velador, a fim de que os que entram vejam a luz.

verses.original: Ὁ λύχνος τοῦ σώματός ἐστιν ὁ ὀφθαλμός σου ὅταν ὁ ὀφθαλμός σου ἁπλοῦς ᾖ καὶ ὅλον τὸ σῶμά σου φωτεινόν ἐστιν ἐπὰν δὲ πονηρὸς ᾖ καὶ τὸ σῶμά σου σκοτεινόν
verses.transliteration: Ho lychnos tou sōmatos estin ho ophthalmos sou hotan ho ophthalmos sou haplous ē kai holon to sōma sou phōteinon estin epan de ponēros ē kai to sōma sou skoteinon
verses.literal: Your eye is the lamp of your body When your eyes are good your whole body also is full of light But when they are bad your body is full of darkness
verses.literalPt: A candeia do corpo são os teus olhos. Quando estes forem simples, todo o teu corpo é luminoso; mas, quando forem maus, todo o teu corpo fica às escuras.

verses.original: σκόπει οὖν μὴ τὸ φῶς τὸ ἐν σοὶ σκότος ἐστίν
verses.transliteration: skopei oun mē to phōs to en soi skotos estin
verses.literal: Be careful then that the light within you is not darkness
verses.literalPt: Vê, então, se a luz que há em ti não são trevas.

verses.original: εἰ οὖν τὸ σῶμά σου ὅλον φωτεινόν μὴ ἔχον μέρος τι σκοτεινόν ἔσται φωτεινὸν ὅλον ὡς ὅταν ὁ λύχνος τῇ ἀστραπῇ φωτίζῃ σε
verses.transliteration: ei oun to sōma sou holon phōteinon mē echon meros ti skoteinon estai phōteinon holon hōs hotan ho lychnos tē astrapē phōtizē se
verses.literal: So if your whole body is full of light with no part of it in darkness you will be radiant as though a lamp were shining . . . on you
verses.literalPt: Pois, se todo o teu corpo for luminoso, sem ter parte alguma em trevas, será inteiramente luminoso, como quando uma candeia te alumiar com a sua luz.

verses.original: Ἐν δὲ τῷ λαλῆσαι ἐρωτᾷ αὐτὸν Φαρισαῖος ὅπως ἀριστήσῃ παρ’ αὐτῷ εἰσελθὼν δὲ ἀνέπεσεν
verses.transliteration: En de tō lalēsai erōta auton Pharisaios hopōs aristēsē par’ autō eiselthōn de anepesen
verses.literal: As Jesus was speaking a Pharisee invited Him to dine with him so He went in and reclined at the table
verses.literalPt: Tendo acabado de falar, um fariseu convidou-o para almoçar com ele; e Jesus, havendo entrado, pôs-se à mesa.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ Φαρισαῖος ἰδὼν ἐθαύμασεν ὅτι οὐ πρῶτον ἐβαπτίσθη πρὸ τοῦ ἀρίστου
verses.transliteration: ho de Pharisaios idōn ethaumasen hoti ou prōton ebaptisthē pro tou aristou
verses.literal: But the Pharisee was surprised to see that Jesus did not first wash . . . before the meal
verses.literalPt: Vendo isso o fariseu, estranhou não se ter ele lavado antes de almoçar.

verses.original: Εἶπεν δὲ ὁ Κύριος πρὸς αὐτόν Νῦν ὑμεῖς οἱ Φαρισαῖοι τὸ ἔξωθεν τοῦ ποτηρίου καὶ τοῦ πίνακος καθαρίζετε τὸ δὲ ἔσωθεν ὑμῶν γέμει ἁρπαγῆς καὶ πονηρίας
verses.transliteration: Eipen de ho Kyrios pros auton Nyn hymeis hoi Pharisaioi to exōthen tou potēriou kai tou pinakos katharizete to de esōthen hymōn gemei harpagēs kai ponērias
verses.literal: Then the Lord said - Now you Pharisees clean the outside of the cup and dish but inside you are full of greed and wickedness
verses.literalPt: O Senhor, porém, disse-lhe: Agora, vós, os fariseus, limpais o exterior do copo e do prato, mas o vosso interior está cheio de rapina e maldade.

verses.original: ἄφρονες οὐχ ὁ ποιήσας τὸ ἔξωθεν καὶ τὸ ἔσωθεν ἐποίησεν
verses.transliteration: aphrones ouch ho poiēsas to exōthen kai to esōthen epoiēsen
verses.literal: You fools Did not the One who made the outside make the inside as well
verses.literalPt: Insensatos, porventura, quem fez o exterior não fez também o interior?

verses.original: πλὴν τὰ ἐνόντα δότε ἐλεημοσύνην καὶ ἰδοὺ πάντα καθαρὰ ὑμῖν ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: plēn ta enonta dote eleēmosynēn kai idou panta kathara hymin estin
verses.literal: But give as alms the things that are within you and behold everything will be clean for you
verses.literalPt: Dai, porém, em esmolas o que está no copo e no prato, e eis que todas as coisas vos são limpas.

verses.original: Ἀλλὰ οὐαὶ ὑμῖν τοῖς Φαρισαίοις ὅτι ἀποδεκατοῦτε τὸ ἡδύοσμον καὶ τὸ πήγανον καὶ πᾶν λάχανον καὶ παρέρχεσθε τὴν κρίσιν καὶ τὴν ἀγάπην τοῦ Θεοῦ ταῦτα δὲ ἔδει ποιῆσαι κἀκεῖνα μὴ παρεῖναι
verses.transliteration: Alla ouai hymin tois Pharisaiois hoti apodekatoute to hēdyosmon kai to pēganon kai pan lachanon kai parerchesthe tēn krisin kai tēn agapēn tou Theou tauta de edei poiēsai kakeina mē pareinai
verses.literal: Woe to you Pharisees For you pay tithes of . . . mint - rue and every herb but you disregard justice and the love of God You should have practiced the latter without neglecting the former
verses.literalPt: Mas ai de vós, fariseus! Porque dais o dízimo da hortelã, da arruda e de todas as hortaliças e desprezais a justiça e o amor de Deus; essas coisas, porém, devíeis fazer sem omitirdes aquelas.

verses.original: Οὐαὶ ὑμῖν τοῖς Φαρισαίοις ὅτι ἀγαπᾶτε τὴν πρωτοκαθεδρίαν ἐν ταῖς συναγωγαῖς καὶ τοὺς ἀσπασμοὺς ἐν ταῖς ἀγοραῖς
verses.transliteration: Ouai hymin tois Pharisaiois hoti agapate tēn prōtokathedrian en tais synagōgais kai tous aspasmous en tais agorais
verses.literal: Woe to you Pharisees For you love the chief seats in the synagogues and the greetings in the marketplaces
verses.literalPt: Ai de vós, fariseus! Porque gostais das primeiras cadeiras nas sinagogas e das saudações nas ruas.

verses.original: οὐαὶ ὑμῖν ὅτι ἐστὲ ὡς τὰ μνημεῖα τὰ ἄδηλα καὶ οἱ ἄνθρωποι οἱ περιπατοῦντες ἐπάνω οὐκ οἴδασιν
verses.transliteration: ouai hymin hoti este hōs ta mnēmeia ta adēla kai hoi anthrōpoi hoi peripatountes epanō ouk oidasin
verses.literal: Woe to you For you are like unmarked graves which men walk over without even noticing
verses.literalPt: Ai de vós! Porque sois semelhantes aos túmulos que não aparecem, sobre os quais andam os homens sem o saberem.

verses.original: Ἀποκριθεὶς δέ τις τῶν νομικῶν λέγει αὐτῷ Διδάσκαλε ταῦτα λέγων καὶ ἡμᾶς ὑβρίζεις
verses.transliteration: Apokritheis de tis tōn nomikōn legei autō Didaskale tauta legōn kai hēmas hybrizeis
verses.literal: One of the experts in the law told Him Teacher when You say these things You insult us as well
verses.literalPt: Então, lhe disse um dos doutores da lei: Mestre, falando tu assim, a nós também nos insultas.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ εἶπεν Καὶ ὑμῖν τοῖς νομικοῖς οὐαί ὅτι φορτίζετε τοὺς ἀνθρώπους φορτία δυσβάστακτα καὶ αὐτοὶ ἑνὶ τῶν δακτύλων ὑμῶν οὐ προσψαύετε τοῖς φορτίοις
verses.transliteration: Ho de eipen Kai hymin tois nomikois ouai hoti phortizete tous anthrōpous phortia dysbastakta kai autoi heni tōn daktylōn hymōn ou prospsauete tois phortiois
verses.literal: Woe to you as well experts in the law - He replied For you weigh men down . . . . . . with heavy burdens . . . but you yourselves will not lift a . . . . . . finger to lighten their load
verses.literalPt: Respondeu Jesus: Ai de vós também, doutores da lei! Porque carregais os homens com fardos difíceis de suportar e vós, nem com um dedo vosso, os tocais.

verses.original: οὐαὶ ὑμῖν ὅτι οἰκοδομεῖτε τὰ μνημεῖα τῶν προφητῶν οἱ δὲ πατέρες ὑμῶν ἀπέκτειναν αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: ouai hymin hoti oikodomeite ta mnēmeia tōn prophētōn hoi de pateres hymōn apekteinan autous
verses.literal: Woe to you For you build tombs for the prophets but it was your fathers who killed them
verses.literalPt: Ai de vós! Porque erigis os túmulos dos profetas que vossos pais mataram.

verses.original: ἄρα μάρτυρές ἐστε καὶ συνευδοκεῖτε τοῖς ἔργοις τῶν πατέρων ὑμῶν ὅτι αὐτοὶ μὲν ἀπέκτειναν αὐτοὺς ὑμεῖς δὲ οἰκοδομεῖτε
verses.transliteration: ara martyres este kai syneudokeite tois ergois tōn paterōn hymōn hoti autoi men apekteinan autous hymeis de oikodomeite
verses.literal: So you are witnesses consenting to the deeds of your fathers They killed the prophets and you build their tombs
verses.literalPt: Assim dais testemunho e consentis nas obras de vossos pais, porque eles os mataram, e vós lhes erigis os túmulos.

verses.original: διὰ τοῦτο καὶ ἡ σοφία τοῦ Θεοῦ εἶπεν Ἀποστελῶ εἰς αὐτοὺς προφήτας καὶ ἀποστόλους καὶ ἐξ αὐτῶν ἀποκτενοῦσιν καὶ διώξουσιν
verses.transliteration: dia touto kai hē sophia tou Theou eipen Apostelō eis autous prophētas kai apostolous kai ex autōn apoktenousin kai diōxousin
verses.literal: Because of this . . . the wisdom of God said I will send them prophets and apostles some of them they will kill and others they will persecute
verses.literalPt: Por isso, também disse a sabedoria de Deus: Enviar-lhes-ei profetas e apóstolos, e a alguns deles matarão e a outros perseguirão,

verses.original: ἵνα ἐκζητηθῇ τὸ αἷμα πάντων τῶν προφητῶν τὸ ἐκκεχυμένον ἀπὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου ἀπὸ τῆς γενεᾶς ταύτης
verses.transliteration: hina ekzētēthē to haima pantōn tōn prophētōn to ekkechymenon apo katabolēs kosmou apo tēs geneas tautēs
verses.literal: As a result this generation will be charged with the blood of all the prophets that has been shed since the foundation of the world
verses.literalPt: para que a esta geração se peça contas do sangue de todos os profetas, derramado desde a fundação do mundo,

verses.original: ἀπὸ αἵματος Ἅβελ ἕως αἵματος Ζαχαρίου τοῦ ἀπολομένου μεταξὺ τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου καὶ τοῦ οἴκου ναί λέγω ὑμῖν ἐκζητηθήσεται ἀπὸ τῆς γενεᾶς ταύτης
verses.transliteration: apo haimatos Habel heōs haimatos Zachariou tou apolomenou metaxy tou thysiastēriou kai tou oikou nai legō hymin ekzētēthēsetai apo tēs geneas tautēs
verses.literal: from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zechariah who was killed between the altar and the sanctuary Yes I tell you all of it will be charged to this generation
verses.literalPt: desde o sangue de Abel até o sangue de Zacarias, que foi morto entre o altar e o santuário; sim, eu vos digo que se pedirá contas a esta geração.

verses.original: Οὐαὶ ὑμῖν τοῖς νομικοῖς ὅτι ἤρατε τὴν κλεῖδα τῆς γνώσεως αὐτοὶ οὐκ εἰσήλθατε καὶ τοὺς εἰσερχομένους ἐκωλύσατε
verses.transliteration: Ouai hymin tois nomikois hoti ērate tēn kleida tēs gnōseōs autoi ouk eisēlthate kai tous eiserchomenous ekōlysate
verses.literal: Woe to you experts in the law For you have taken away the key to knowledge You yourselves have not entered and you have hindered those who were entering
verses.literalPt: Ai de vós, doutores da lei! Porque tirastes a chave da ciência; vós mesmos não entrastes e impedistes aos que entravam.

verses.original: Κἀκεῖθεν ἐξελθόντος αὐτοῦ ἤρξαντο οἱ γραμματεῖς καὶ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι δεινῶς ἐνέχειν καὶ ἀποστοματίζειν αὐτὸν περὶ πλειόνων
verses.transliteration: Kakeithen exelthontos autou ērxanto hoi grammateis kai hoi Pharisaioi deinōs enechein kai apostomatizein auton peri pleionōn
verses.literal: As Jesus went on from there the scribes and Pharisees began to oppose Him bitterly and to ply Him with questions . . . about many things
verses.literalPt: Ao sair ele dali, os escribas e fariseus começaram a apertá-lo fortemente e a importuná-lo com perguntas sobre muitos assuntos,

verses.original: ἐνεδρεύοντες αὐτὸν θηρεῦσαί τι ἐκ τοῦ στόματος αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: enedreuontes auton thēreusai ti ek tou stomatos autou
verses.literal: waiting to catch Him in something He might say . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: armando-lhe ciladas, a fim de o apanhar em algumas das suas respostas.
